inputs:
Mr. Smith went to Washington on Jan. 5 of this year. He met Dr. Jones there. The U.S. government was closed, e.g. on weekends. Mrs. Brown, however, was not amused.
They visited St. Louis and then flew to Los Angeles. It was 3 p.m. when they landed. J. R. R. Tolkien wrote books. Prof. Adams teaches at the univ. in town. Mr. Smith and Dr. Jones agreed. The meeting ended at 5 p.m. Everyone left.

In 1999. the company grew. Sales rose 5.2 per cent. in Q3. A new CEO, Mr. Lee, arrived. Mr. Lee said: "We will grow." Then he smiled. Dr. Jones replied (quietly). The No. 1 priority is safety. Fig. 3 shows the results. See vol. 2, p. 14 for details. He arrived at approx. 9 o'clock. They wanted cheap and fast service... It never came. Mrs. Brown wrote to Mr. Smith.
